title: 小火箭升空
subject: A large endearing rounded little rocket joyfully whooshes upward from one BIG soft cloud, in a playful tilted pose. Its organic body has ONE large simple porthole, TWO wide fins, and a tail flame made of ONLY TWO broad enclosed lobes. Give it a happy expression with solid-black simple eyes and an open smile curve. No rivets, panel stripes, tiny flame tongues, exhaust bubbles, extra stars, or machinery details. The single broad cloud supports the funny launch story.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Subject for THIS SINGLE illustration: A large endearing rounded little rocket joyfully whooshes upward from one BIG soft cloud, in a playful tilted pose. Its organic body has ONE large simple porthole, TWO wide fins, and a tail flame made of ONLY TWO broad enclosed lobes. Give it a happy expression with solid-black simple eyes and an open smile curve. No rivets, panel stripes, tiny flame tongues, exhaust bubbles, extra stars, or machinery details. The single broad cloud supports the funny launch story.

Critical simplification: draw the porthole with ONLY ONE enclosing contour, NO double-line rim, ring or narrow annular band. Put simple solid-black eyes and a SINGLE OPEN CURVE smile on the large window; NO enclosed tongue or mouth patch. Any collar/nozzle section must be very broad, never a thin strip. Every enclosed white part must accommodate a circle at least 60/1000 of the whole picture. Keep the flame in two large clean lobes. Leave a safe white margin around the rocket nose.
